agents.task: Implement federated-search plan Step 2 only, reading the landed retrieval/fusion.py and ProviderPrefs (core/interfaces.py) first (do not change their shapes). (a) Manager federated strategy: parallel fan-out over enabled providers (bounded ThreadPoolExecutor, max_workers = min(selected, 16)) with per-provider timeout_s plus overall deadline federated_timeout_s (providers strategy section, NOT a per-provider entry; default = max per-provider bound + 1s; validated 0 < value <= MAX_TIMEOUT_S). Extract thread-free _invoke(name, request) from _search_one; single/fallback keep the existing thread-bound wrapper; federated submits _invoke and collects with the overall deadline (shutdown(wait=False) on expiry; late daemon threads recorded as timeouts, never awaited). Partial failure degrades (survivor results + per-provider errors recorded, never silently drops a provider); empty from all providers is success with zero hits; all-failed raises one ProviderError (code unavailable) naming every attempted provider, each failure also in context.errors. (b) Engine delegation: SearchEngine gains an optional manager-backed constructor path (SearchEngine.from_manager(manager, plugins=...) or optional manager= argument) and delegates provider selection to the manager (single-owner routing; engine keeps pipeline + ranker + response assembly); the existing SearchEngine(providers=[...]) list constructor keeps working for shipped tests; build_engine switches to the manager path (this puts the timeout bound on the live path).
